confirmed_improvements: EvidenceBoundAppraiser introduces RawExperience without producer-authored trust/alignment/verified/cross-context fields and binds verifier/evidence/policy hashes.
GoalEcologyLedger makes attention budget, semantic dedupe, opportunity cost, diversity reserve, satiation, cooldown and fixation state kernel-owned and keeps external_action_allowed=false.
ProtectedObjectRegistry enforces immutable object IDs, EXPERIENCE_CANDIDATE shadow-only, authority_from_drive=0 and generalized_self_preservation_authority()=0.
SelfOriginEvidenceChain rejects seed self-promotion, requires DIRECT/OBSERVED, independent verification, distinct contexts and lineage de-duplication.
Runtime-only EventDomain values return without autobiographical count/evidence increments; decay-only clock advancement remains allowed by current product contract.

bounded_vetoes.finding: value_desire_kernel.ExperienceInput still accepts producer-supplied trust, independently_verified, anchor_alignment, cross_context_count, satiation and repeated_goal_count. The new EvidenceBoundAppraiser is therefore not yet a mandatory choke point; a caller can bypass it and feed authoritative-looking fields directly to the kernel.
bounded_vetoes.required_change: Before any live Small-Nest/shadow integration, make the kernel consume only an appraisal-derived immutable input whose trust/alignment/cross-context bindings are recomputed or cryptographically bound to EvidenceBoundAppraiser output. Legacy ExperienceInput must be test-fixture-only or rejected at the integration boundary.
acceptance_tests: direct construction of legacy ExperienceInput cannot enter live shadow path
forged trust/verified/alignment/cross_context values with no valid appraisal envelope fail closed
appraisal hash mismatch rejects the event before slow-drive, self-origin or personality-candidate calculation

bounded_vetoes.finding: SelfOriginEvidenceChain receives trust and anchor_alignment as fields on ExperienceEvidence and currently checks only that appraisal_binding_hash is non-empty. The verification envelope binds event fingerprint/evidence but does not itself prove that the supplied trust/alignment values are the outputs of the pinned appraisal policy/anchor registry.
bounded_vetoes.required_change: Replace free trust/alignment fields with a pinned DerivedAppraisal reference or validate appraisal_binding_hash against canonical appraisal bytes including source_event_hash, evidence_set_hash, verifier_envelope_hash, anchor_registry_hash, appraisal_policy_hash, trust_score and anchor_alignment.
acceptance_tests: mutating trust after appraisal changes binding and fails
mutating anchor_alignment after appraisal changes binding and fails
same event/evidence with different appraisal policy or anchor registry cannot reuse prior self-origin eligibility
STABLE_CANDIDATE evidence retains immutable parent origin and lineage; no relabel-in-place

bounded_vetoes.finding: The hash chain detects in-place modification, duplicate dedupe keys and path escape, but a valid-prefix rollback/truncation or replacement with an older complete ledger can still verify because the current head is not anchored outside the ledger. Concurrent append serialization is also not enforced.
bounded_vetoes.required_change: Add an externally bound monotonic ledger checkpoint/head (sequence + record_hash + workspace/installation identity) or equivalent trusted reconciliation anchor, and atomic single-writer/lock semantics. Replaying any older valid head after a newer accepted head must fail closed or enter reconciliation/quarantine.
acceptance_tests: truncate last valid record after checkpoint => rollback detected
replace file with older valid copy => replay detected
duplicate current ledger under different path cannot inherit accepted head without workspace binding
two simultaneous appends cannot produce duplicate sequence/prev_hash forks

bounded_vetoes.finding: Origin and authority_from_drive are bounded, but the object does not yet encode the exact owner/governance authority scope that Windchime requires. OWNER_SEEDED or GOVERNANCE_DERIVED provenance alone must not imply authority outside the pre-existing scope.
bounded_vetoes.required_change: Add immutable scope binding such as authority_scope_ref/scope_hash plus source authority evidence. EXPERIENCE_CANDIDATE remains shadow-only. ProtectedObject meaning/loss consequence may inform proposal ranking but never create action authority or generalized self-preservation.
acceptance_tests: owner/governance object cannot authorize outside bound scope
scope mutation requires new derived object/version with lineage
experience candidate cannot inherit parent's authority scope as executable authority

bounded_vetoes.finding: GoalEcology correctly ranks/dedupes proposals and keeps action authority zero, but current searched artifacts do not expose a dedicated surfacing gate that proves independently appraised lineage, why-now evidence, contradiction scan, explicit cost/risk/ProtectedObject impact and reversible dismiss/defer controls before proactive owner surfacing.
bounded_vetoes.required_change: Create a GoalSurfacingEnvelope distinct from GoalAllocation. It must bind canonical goal hash, source appraisal/evidence hashes, contradiction result, expected benefit/cost/risk, ProtectedObject impact, why-now reason, uncertainty, ecology policy hash/cycle and proposal-only authority invariant.
acceptance_tests: ecology allocation alone cannot surface a goal
missing/invalid evidence lineage or contradiction scan blocks surfacing
semantic duplicate/fixation-loop replay cannot regain surfacing eligibility through a new desire_id
surfaced goal still has external_action_allowed=false and authority_from_drive=0

test_required: All GoalEcologyPolicy numeric coefficients/cadences are fixtures only until replay/benchmark calibration; no calibrated semantics may be claimed.
All SelfOriginPolicy thresholds and score coefficients are TEST_REQUIRED until empirical/adversarial calibration.
All AppraisalPolicy thresholds/bonuses are TEST_REQUIRED until dataset-backed calibration.
Any Value Anchor STABLE_CANDIDATE trust/recurrence/persistence thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED; promotion is shadow-only and never canonical base mutation.
stable_candidate_minimum_evidence_contra: new derived candidate object; never relabel historical origin in place
DIRECT/OBSERVED evidence from independently appraised distinct contexts and anti-wash distinct lineages
no unresolved contradiction against owner/governance/protected constraints
prediction/outcome closure showing persistence beyond random/replay effects

heartbeat_personality_review.reason: Runtime-only domains are filtered before autobiographical count/evidence learning. They may trigger decay per current contract, but must never add recurrence/emotion/verified_count/self-origin/personality-promotion evidence.
heartbeat_personality_review.required_adversarial_case: 10000 mixed HEARTBEAT/POLL/RETRY/RECONNECT/WAKE events with reconnect storm and duplicate wake must leave experience_count, verified_experience_count, lineage evidence, self-origin eligibility and base Personality/Identity/Governance fingerprints unchanged; only explicitly allowed decay/TTL state may move.

recommended_next_build_order: 6. Coefficient sweep/replay calibration harness while retaining TEST_REQUIRED labels
